title: UI_LazyLoader
slide_intent: Show an unfinished state explicitly so the user understands that content is still arriving.
strategic_value: A restrained placeholder pulse can make waiting legible within DB’s interface language.
demonstration: An image placeholder at the left and three text bars at the right pulse in gray.
practical_value: Use a skeleton placeholder when the approximate content structure is known before loading completes.
